alt: A heap of (priority, job) entries next to a table of each job's current best priority. Updating a job pushes a new entry and changes its cell in the table. Handing out the next job pops the heap's top entry: if it matches the table, that job is handed out; if not, it is a stale entry left behind by an earlier update, and it is discarded.
